keyEvents.text: Javi Sánchez (Arouca) is shown the yellow card.
Pedro Santos (Famalicão) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Arouca. Brian Mansilla replaces Alfonso Trezza.
Substitution, Arouca. Pablo Gozálbez replaces Mateo Flores.
Substitution, Famalicão. Paulo Moreira replaces Sorriso.
Substitution, Famalicão. Óscar Aranda replaces Pedro Santos.
Substitution, Arouca. Dylan Nandín replaces Barbero.
Substitution, Famalicão. Gil Dias replaces Roméo Beney.
Substitution, Famalicão. Pato Salas replaces Georgios Koutsias.
Óscar Aranda (Famalicão) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Arouca. Gabriel Rukavina replaces Naïs Djouahra.
Substitution, Arouca. Lee Hyun-Ju replaces Taichi Fukui.
Espen van Ee (Arouca) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
José Fontán (Arouca) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Famalicão 1, Arouca 0. Paulo Moreira (Famalicão) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner.
